title: Four cans
logline: The dock at dusk, four cans on the planks in a row, the chairs empty, the water going pink. The count the sequence keeps: two, then four. Nobody in the page.

panels.composition: Four beer cans in a row on dock planks at dusk, three empty chairs behind them, the bay pink, the shack's window lit.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, four beer cans in a row on wooden dock planks at dusk with three empty chairs behind them, a pink bay and a shingle shack's lit window, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
